_meanings:
.²1 A house, dwelling, habitation, mansion; {#na gfhaM gfhamityAhurgfhiRI#}
 {#gfhamucyate#} <ls>Pt. 4. 81</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">5. 15</ls>; {#paSya vAnaramUrKeRa sugfhI nirgfhIkftaH#} <ls>Pt. 1. 390</ls>.
.²2 A wife; (the first quotation in 1 is sometimes erroneously cited as
 an illustration).
.²3 The life of a householder; {#na hi sati kulavurye sUryavaMSyA gfhAya#}
 <ls>R. 7. 71</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 10</ls>; <ls>Mv. 4. 28</ls>.
.²4 A sign of the zodiac.
.²5 A name or appellation.
.²6 A square (in chess or any other game).

<ab>Ved.</ab> An assistant, or servant; {#gfho yAmyaraMkfto deveByo#}
 {#havyavAhanaH#} <ls>Rv. 10. 119. 13</ls>. In <ab>comp.</ab> <ab>oft.</ab> rendered by ‘domestic’,
 ‘household’ or ‘tame’; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {#˚kapotaH#} ‘a tame pigeon’; {#˚kAryARi-karmARi#}
 ‘household duties’; {#˚SakuntikA#} ‘tame bird’; {#CadmanA paridadAmi#}
 {#mftyave sOniko gfhaSakuntikAmiva#} <ls>U. 1. 45</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>
a loophole, eyelet-hole, a round or oblong window.

.²1 a house-holder.
.²2 a regent of a sign of the zodiac. {#saMSayasTaH#} see {#anupAta#}.

a flat oblong stone upon which condiments are

 ground (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>{#pAwA#}</ns>).
one who has come to a house.
, {#-vAwI, vAwikA#} a garden attached to a house.

the order of a householder, the second stage in the religious
 life of a Bāhmaṇa; see {#ASrama#}; <ls>Ms. 6. 1</ls>.

a domestic utensil, anything required for household
 use; {#ekadA nirgatA kretuM gfhopakaraRAni sA#} <ls>Ks. 20. 150</ls>.

.²1 ‘a house-builder’, a kind of sparrow.
.²2 a carpenter; {#gfhakartA BavAneva devAnAM hfdayepsitam#} <ls>Rām. 7. 5. 19</ls>.

a menial, domestic servant;
 {#SaMBusvayaMBuharayo hariRekzaRAnAM yenAkriyanta satataM gfhakarmadAsAH#} <ls>Bh. 1. 1</ls>.

.²1 a house-builder.
.²2 a kind of wasp.

a house with two rooms contiguous to each other, but one
 facing west, the other east; <ls>Bṛ. S. 53. 40</ls>.

.²1 a family-secret or scandal.
.²2 family dissensions; {#AyurvittaM gfhacCidraM mantramETunaBezajam#} <ls>H. 1. 123</ls>.
born in the house (a slave <ab>&c.</ab>); <ls>Bṛ. S. 61. 7</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 415</ls>.
family, members of a family, especially the wife; <ls>Mu. 1</ls>.

(also {#gfhejYAnin#}) ‘wise only in the inside of the
 house’, inexperienced, stupid, foolish.
a terrace in front of the house.
setting a house on fire, incendiarism.

a female domestic slave; {#ekadA gfhadAsIzu yaSodA nandagehinI .#}
 {#karmAntaraniyuktAsu nirmamanTa svayaM daDi ..#} <ls>Bhāg. 10. 9. 1</ls>.

the splendour or ornament of a house, a virtuous
 woman; {#prajanArTaM mahABAgAH pUjArhA gfhadIptayaH#} <ls>Ms. 9. 26</ls>.
the goddess of a house; (<ab>pl.</ab>) a class of household deities; <ls>Ks. 4. 74</ls>.
the threshold of a house; {#yAsAM baliH sapadi madgfhadehalInAm#} <ls>Mk. 1. 9</ls>.

.²1 a householder; {#vAmaM gfhapatiM naya#} <ls>Rv. 6. 53. 2</ls>; a man who has
 entered on the second stage of life, one who, after having completed his
 studies, is married and settled.
.²2 a sacrificer.
.²3 the virtue of a householder; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} hospitality.
.²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> an epithet of Agni.
.²5 the maintenance of the sacred and perpetual fire.
.²6 the

 head or judge of a village; <ls>Mk. 2</ls>; <ls>Dk. 8</ls>.

<ab>Ved.</ab> ‘the mistress of a house’, the wife of the householder;
 {#gfhAn gacCa gfhapatnI yaTAsaH#} <ls>Rv. 10. 85. 26</ls>.

.²1 the guardian of a house.
.²2 a house-dog; {#Aste'vamatyopanyastaM gfhapAla ivAharan#} <ls>Bhāg. 3. 30. 15</ls>.

the site of a house, the ground on which it stands and
 which surrounds it.

maintenance of a household; {#tena cAsya niyuktABUtsvaBAryA#}
 {#gfhapozaRe#} <ls>Ks. 2. 55</ls>.
a solemn entrance into a house according to prescribed rites.

a domestic oblation, offering of the remnants of a meal
 to all creatures, such as animals, supernatural beings, and particularly
 household deities; <ls>Ms. 3. 265</ls>.
a deity to whom a domestic oblation is offered.

.²1 one who is driven from his house, an exile.
.²2 destroying a house.
.²3 breaking into a house.
.²4 failure, ruin or destruction of a house, firm <ab>&c.</ab>

.²1 breaking down or destroying a house.
.²2 causing the decay or ruin of a family.
the master of a house; <ls>Bṛ. S. 53. 58</ls>.

.²1 prying into domestic affairs.
.²2 causing domestic quarrels.

an inmate of the same house, tenant; {#tasmAdapyagrahArAnye#}
 {#jagfhurgfhaBojinaH#} <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 403</ls>.

a female servant of the house; {#saKyopetyAgrahItpARiM#}
 {#yo'haM tadgfhamArjanI#} <ls>Bhāg. 10. 83. 11</ls>.

.²1 one who performs the domestic rites or sacrifices; {#gfhameDAsa A#}
 {#gata maruto mApa BUtana#} <ls>Rv. 7. 59. 10</ls>.
.²2 connected with the duties of a householder.

a stick or other instrument to which, on solemn occasions,
 flags are fastened; {#gfhayantrapatAkASrIrapOrAdaranirmitA#} <ls>Ku. 6. 41</ls>.
a garden attached to a house.

devoted to home; {#matirna kfzRe parataH svato vA#}
 {#miTo'Bipadyeta gfhavratAnAm#} <ls>Bhāg. 7. 5. 30</ls>.

the life of a

 householder; see {#gfhASrama#}.
